author: KroestV2
body:
This is my new map, Connected III. The woolroom is the center of the map. Team sizes are 20v20. I may add iron on the map. There is a tunnel system under the map to provide another way of ground rushing the woolroom. Players spawn with full leather armor. 

This map propably needs a bit of testing since its quite different to other CTW maps.





album: http://imgur.com/a/OOvWN
download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/f4shxf0k3mir83b/AADZZGwqUOS-tsPcHKvEbk-Ra?dl=0 (Avicus xml coming soon)
